summary.file_check: Raw files written in the AncestryDNA, 23andMe, MyHeritage, FamilyTreeDNA, Living DNA and VCF layouts (including a GRCh38 VCF) are read back with every genotype exact.
summary.pca: Genomes reduced to about 252,881 SNPs (a genotyping chip's worth) land a median 0.29% of the map's width from where the same genomes land with all 1.15 million SNPs (186 placements of 93 held-out genomes).
summary.neanderthal: On 93 held-out genomes reduced to chip size, the 95% interval contained the estimate from all 1.15 million SNPs in 100% of cases.
summary.ancient_ancestry: Athanor's qpAdm reproduces ADMIXTOOLS qpAdm [0.524, 0.282, 0.195] with [0.524, 0.282, 0.194] on a well-powered simulation: every weight agrees to within 0.0006 and every standard error to within 0.0003, and both recover the simulated proportions [0.5, 0.3, 0.2] to within 0.024. On 1 of 1 held-out present-day population targets, Athanor's qpAdm agrees with ADMIXTOOLS qpAdm (v8.0.2) to within two standard errors (largest difference 0.047).
summary.y_haplogroup: On 600 ancient men with published Y haplogroups, Athanor's call from the 1240K Y-chromosome SNPs was on the same lineage in 98% and identical in 34%.
